formula.Phi1_control_scope: The ambient-conserved but observed-nonconserved Phi1 control is an off-shell field; it is not asserted to be a stationary connection.
formula.coderivative: D_B^dagger T=-sum_i (1/d_i)([beta_i,T_i]-sum_k Lambda[i][i][k]*T_k) for invariant coefficients.
formula.connection_shift: D_(B+fT)^dagger T-D_B^dagger T=-f G^ij[T_i,T_j]=0 by symmetry of G^ij and antisymmetry of the bracket, for arbitrary smooth T and real scalar f(x). There is no derivative of f in this connection difference.
formula.descent_defect: For every invariant one-form, D_B^dagger(T)=D_(s*Ahat)^dagger(s*T)-T_4/4. Geometry proves the formula before restriction to the real/reflection59 family. It is not an observed Einstein-stress divergence.
formula.literal_observation: At the flat section with induced4D LC=0 and the full ambient adjoint bundle retained, D_(s*Ahat)^dagger(s*T)=-sum_h<4 [beta_h,T_h]/d_h.
formula.scalar_native_control: D_B^dagger(i theta4 Id)=-i Id/4. Rational Id computation is complexified; iId is native H-skew.
formula.weak_formula: Transpose [beta_i,.] with native trace/form weights and add -div(e_i)*T_i/d_i. Derivatives of invariant coefficients vanish; frame divergence does not.
